scope: Reporting-cadence subprocess output and failure reporting

behavior.stdout_stderr: Report generator stdout/stderr are no longer returned to callers; only a boolean output-availability indicator is exposed.
behavior.nonzero_exit: A failed command retains failed status and numeric exit code with a bounded error summary; cadence completion is not recorded.
behavior.exception: Subprocess and completion errors return/log only the exception class, and the cursor is closed.

coverage: secret-bearing stdout/stderr are absent from failed command results
successful report output is not returned and completion still occurs
subprocess exception details are absent from result/log and cursor cleanup remains

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; fake connection and mocked subprocess

limitations: No report generator subprocess or database was started.
This does not verify that a real report artifact was generated, delivered, or stored.
